summary.name: Inboxen
summary.one_liner: Inboxen is an open source Python project (GPL-3.0) that lets you create an effectively unlimited number of unique email inboxes.
use_cases: create a separate email address for each website signup
reduce spam by using unique addresses
manage many inboxes under one account
